{{Quote|Will you quit ''complaining'', Han! At least the ''rain's'' stopped!"''<br />''"Yeah! Now we're into Daluuj's ''fog season!'' It's just as ''wet''&hellip;but we don't have to ''see'' how miserable this planet is!|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref>}}
'''Daluuj''' was a lightly populated [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered with barren canyons and muddy slopes.

==Description==
{{Quote|Terrific little planet&hellip;if you like blinding rain and mist!|Han Solo|<ref name="It's a Trap" />}}
Daluuj was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a temperate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], standard gravity, and two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Its surface was covered with barren canyons and muddy slopes. Its rotational period lasted 28 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and its orbital period lasted 391 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:Daluuj.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Daluuj]]

===Early history===
Daluuj was originally colonized by [[Human/Legends|humans]]<ref name="LECG" /> at some point after [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was considered to be within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Rebellion era===
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] [[Battle of Daluuj|crashed]] on the planet while ''en route'' from [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had just rescued [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] from his wrecked smuggling ship on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] when they intercepted the distress signal sent out from the Admiral's transport.

Following the trail of the Admiral's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to Daluuj, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] managed to enter the planet's storm-wracked atmosphere, narrowly missing the gun turret of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Training Center|fort]] in the process. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Solo set the ''Falcon'' down on what appeared at first to be an ordinary mud plain, only to find out too late that it was in fact a lake occupied by two [[Lake worm|giant worms]] that quickly twined themselves about the stricken ship, dragging it to the bottom of the lake.

Only with the assistance of Admiral Ackbar and his fellow [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] able to raise the ''Falcon'' and evade the Imperial forces led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Orlok]]. In doing so, the Rebels lured Orlok's [[Imperial ground-skimmer|ground-skimmers]] across the mud lake, trapping him and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the coils of the giant mud-worms that had previously held the ''Falcon'', and thus make their escape. Solo later noted in the ''Falcon''{{'s}} owner's guide that emptying the ''Falcon'' of water and mud after leaving Daluuj took several hours, despite the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]'s claims about the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]]'s water resistance.<ref name="Star Wars: Millennium Falcon: A 3-D Owner's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Millennium Falcon: A 3-D Owner's Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] suffered a defeat here sometime prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Entrenched">{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

===Legacy era===
After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], many [[Yuuzhan Vong]] relocated to Daluuj, taking advantage of its breathable atmosphere. The [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]] maintained only a small presence on the planet.<ref name="LECG" />

In [[137 ABY]], it was the location of the [[ambush on Daluuj]] where a conclave of four of the last remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Wolf Sazen]], [[Shado Vao]], and [[Ahn Rasi Tuum]], was held before being attacked by the [[One Sith|Sith]]. At this location, hundreds of impaled [[Droid/Legends|droid]] heads stood on sticks as for a ritual. Cade Skywalker would [[Mission to Daluuj|return]] to Daluuj during his hunt for [[Vul Isen]] along with his master Wolf Sazen and his crew.

==Inhabitants==
Daluuj had a sparse population of Humans, who comprised 88% of the population, and various other species that lived in villages and small cities. Yuuzhan Vong, who comprised 6% of the population, usually lived in isolation away from other settlements.<ref name="LECG" />
